title: Third-party scorer kwargs must not carry LLM endpoint destination keys
answers: server makes outbound requests to a host the user chose when running a judge
SSRF through custom api_base on a TruLens or LiteLLM scorer
why does registering a scorer with api_base return 400
judge endpoint should be configured on the server, not in the scorer payload
body:
Symptom: a user who registers or invokes a third-party judge (TruLens, RAGAS, DeepEval, Phoenix) with a custom api_base makes the MLflow server connect to an arbitrary host when the scorer runs (SSRF).
Root cause: mlflow/utils/validation.py:_validate_third_party_scorer_data was missing, so third_party_scorer_data.kwargs reached the wrapped library's LLM client unchanged; the TruLens LiteLLM fallback forwards them into every litellm.completion() call.
Fix pattern: reject any key in GATEWAY_DESTINATION_KEYS (api_base, base_url, model_list, fallbacks, custom_llm_provider) at any nesting depth inside kwargs, and call the check on the server before any deserialization.
Constraints: payloads without these keys are untouched; server-side endpoints via 'gateway:/' or provider env vars remain allowed. Do not relax this on the client side only, since the REST API can bypass the client.
applies: Any server handler or store path that accepts or reconstructs third_party_scorer_data from a caller-supplied serialized scorer.
says: Registering an external evaluation judge with a custom address returns a bad request error.
Running an evaluation metric allows callers to force our server to contact arbitrary external networks.
Prevent external judge registration from redirecting backend server traffic to arbitrary web addresses.
Allow evaluation judges to connect through server gateway routes while blocking custom destination endpoints.
search: Third-party scorer kwargs must be validated before deserialization on the server to reject LLM endpoint destination keys at any nesting depth and prevent SSRF. Validation is performed in mlflow/utils/validation.py:_validate_third_party_scorer_data using _find_destination_keys to reject keys in GATEWAY_DESTINATION_KEYS (api_base, base_url, model_list, fallbacks, custom_llm_provider). Applies to any server handler or store path accepting third_party_scorer_data, while server-side endpoints via 'gateway:/' or provider env vars remain allowed. Do not relax this on the client side only, since the REST API can bypass the client.
